+    def _update_selection_poly(self, vmin, vmax):

+        Update the vertices of the *self.poly* slider in-place
+        to cover the data range *vmin*, *vmax*.
+        """
+        # The vertices are positioned
+        #  1 ------ 2
+        #  |        |
+        #  0, 4 --- 3
+        # Note: the 5th vertex needs to be the same as the first for the
+        # polygon to be closed (it is redundant but is kept in sync anyway,
+        # in case ``self.poly`` was constructed with a different number of
+        # vertices, e.g. because ``vmin == vmax`` when the slider is
+        # created).

+        else:
+            xy = [[vmin, .25], [vmin, .75], [vmax, .75], [vmax, .25],
+                  [vmin, .25]]
+        self.poly.xy = xy
